# Raka Alpiansyah — Software & AI Engineer Portfolio

> Official engineering portfolio of Raka Alpiansyah, an Informatics Engineering student and Software & AI Engineer based in Bandung, Indonesia, specializing in high-throughput backend systems (Laravel, FastAPI, REST APIs), AI/ML engineering (Whisper AI, TensorFlow, Computer Vision), enterprise blockchain (Hyperledger Fabric), and cross-platform Flutter mobile applications.

Raka Alpiansyah builds production-grade backend architectures, intelligent AI pipelines, and modern full-stack web and mobile applications with clean code principles.

## Portfolio Sections

- [Hero & Overview](https://rakaalpiansyah.site/#hero): Introduction to Raka Alpiansyah, Informatics Engineering & Software Engineer in Bandung, Indonesia.
- [About & Milestones](https://rakaalpiansyah.site/#about): Academic background at Universitas Nasional Pasim (GPA 3.82/4.00), Full Programming Scholarship, 1st Place Web Design Winner at Universitas Jambi, and Alibaba Cloud & Dicoding certifications.
- [Technical Skills & Stack](https://rakaalpiansyah.site/#skills): Interactive 16-keycap technical matrix covering Linux, Docker, Git, Cisco, Laravel, PHP, MySQL, Oracle, Flutter, Dart, React, TypeScript, Java, JavaScript, REST APIs, and Python AI.
- [Featured Engineering Projects](https://rakaalpiansyah.site/#projects): Deep-dive case studies of 6 production software, AI, blockchain, and mobile systems.
- [Experience & Education](https://rakaalpiansyah.site/#experience): Industry track record at PT. Sonasoft, PT. Royale Essence Indonesia, and PT. Pos Indonesia.
- [Contact & Collaboration](https://rakaalpiansyah.site/#contact): Direct communication channels for software engineering, backend, and AI roles.

## Featured Engineering Projects

- [Rehat — Digital Detox & Mindfulness App](https://github.com/rakaalpiansyah/rehat-app): Cross-platform Flutter & Dart mobile application published on Google Play Store for digital wellbeing and screen-time management.
- [Meeting AI Backend — Whisper Speech Diarization](https://github.com/rakaalpiansyah/Meeting-AI-Backend): Python 3.11 & FastAPI microservice powered by Whisper AI and PyTorch for automated meeting transcription and speaker diarization.
- [AgriTraceChain — Enterprise Blockchain Supply Chain](https://github.com/rakaalpiansyah/agritraceChain): 5-organization Hyperledger Fabric permissioned blockchain network with 4 smart contracts and Caliper benchmarking.
- [PlantVillage AI — Leaf Disease Detection CNN](https://github.com/rakaalpiansyah/plantvillage-disease-detection): 4-block Convolutional Neural Network achieving 97.12% validation accuracy and quantized to TensorFlow Lite (~6ms CPU inference).
- [GreenV — Sustainable Waste Management Platform](https://github.com/rakaalpiansyah/web-GreenV): Award-winning (1st Place National Web Design, Universitas Jambi) Laravel platform converting verified waste recycling into Eco Points.
